name: artemis entreri
lore:
To encounter Artemis Entreri is to witness the ultimate refinement of the human predator. He does not inhabit the green wild, but the jagged ecology of the urban underbelly. His behavior is defined by a terrifying economy of motion; he wastes no breath on boasts and no energy on flourish.

Like a winter wolf in a man’s skin, he is governed by a cold, mechanical discipline. He does not kill for passion or zeal, but with the detached precision of a clockmaker dismantling a timepiece. In a crowd, he is a shadow—unremarkable and grey. Yet, when he strikes, his focus is absolute, a singular void where morality has been excised to make room for peerless lethality. Should you see the glint of a jeweled dagger or feel a sudden, unnatural chill, do not draw your steel. Pray, instead, that you are not his mark.
